summary: Four backcountry skiers from Aspen got turned around in whiteout conditions in the mountains above Taylor Park, broke into the Forest Service's Dorchester Cabin and spent the night; found around noon as CBSAR and Mountain Rescue Aspen teams converged on Taylor Park, all in good shape
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search and Rescue; Mountain Rescue Aspen
notes: Overdue reported by family Monday 2011-03-28; Aspen two-man team spent Tuesday night at Goodwin Green Hut; found ~noon Wed 2011-03-30; party carried no tent, compass, or map
